data.body_html:
After crossing the finish line of Ironman 2046, your body deserves more than just a cold beer. A Marbella yacht charter for Ironman 2046 recovery day offers the perfect way to unwind: zero-impact relaxation, Mediterranean sun, and a crew that takes care of everything. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet of luxury boats lets you float away the race-day fatigue while sipping chilled cava and soaking up coastal views. Whether you’re celebrating with teammates or recovering solo, a day on the water beats any hotel pool.

Why a Yacht Charter is Ideal for Post-Ironman Recovery

Ironman 2046 pushes your body to the limit — 3.8 km swim, 180 km bike, and a full marathon. The day after, active recovery is key. Gentle swimming in calm coves, stretching on a spacious deck, and the gentle rocking of the boat help reduce muscle soreness. Plus, the sea air and vitamin D boost your mood without any pounding impact. A Marbella yacht charter turns recovery into a luxury experience.

Our Fleet for Recovery Charters

We offer boats for every group size. All depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella’s most glamorous marina, and include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish VAT. Here’s a quick overview:

What’s Included on Every Charter

No hidden costs. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper and crew
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • 21% Spanish VAT (IVA)

You can bring your own food or extra drinks — no corkage fee. The crew will help with serving.

Best Routes for a Recovery Day

From Puerto Banús, you have several options. A 2-hour charter is perfect for a quick spin along the Golden Mile, past Marbella’s luxury villas and the iconic La Concha mountain. For a longer recovery, head east to Cala del Faro, a quiet cove with crystal water ideal for a gentle swim. Or go west to the sandy beaches of Estepona, where you can anchor and enjoy lunch. The 8-hour charter allows time to reach Sotogrande or even the Cabopino dunes. The skipper will tailor the route to your energy levels.

Pricing Options for Every Budget

We keep pricing transparent. For a small group of athletes (up to 9), the Astondoa 40 at €749 for 2 hours is a steal. Upgrade to 8 hours for €2,299 — that’s less than €256 per person for a full day on the water. For a more luxurious experience, the Mangusta 80 (4 hours minimum, €4,719) includes a jet ski for post-race adrenaline or just cruising. All other boats are priced on request — just contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

How to Book Your Recovery Charter

Booking is simple. Visit our Marbella yacht charter page, select your preferred boat, and send us a WhatsApp message. We’ll confirm availability, arrange the exact departure time (usually 10:00 or 14:00), and answer any questions. Cancellation is free up to 48 hours before departure. For Ironman 2046 participants, we recommend booking at least a week in advance — recovery spots fill fast.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long should I charter a boat for post-Ironman recovery?

For a relaxing recovery day, a 4-hour charter is ideal. You can swim, sunbathe, and enjoy the coastal views without feeling rushed. If you want to explore further, an 8-hour charter allows time to visit Cala del Faro or even Estepona.

Which boat is best for a small group of Ironman athletes?

For up to 9 people, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) is a great choice. For up to 11, the Azimut 39 offers more space. Both are Tier A boats with all inclusions. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (up to 12 pax) includes a free jet ski.

Can I bring my own food or drinks on board?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks. Our charters already include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. There is no corkage fee, and the crew will help with serving.

What happens if the weather is bad on race day?

Your safety is our priority. If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we will reschedule your charter or offer a full refund. The Mediterranean is generally calm in summer, but we monitor forecasts closely.

Do I need a boating license to charter a yacht?

No, you do not need a license. All our charters include a licensed skipper who handles navigation, docking, and safety. You can simply relax and enjoy the experience.

Can I depart from a marina other than Puerto Banús?

All our boats are based at Puerto Banús. Departure from other marinas such as Marbella Marina or Cabopino may be possible for an additional fee, subject to availability. Please inquire via WhatsApp.

Is there a toilet or shower on board?

Yes, all our boats have a toilet and a freshwater shower. After the race, you can rinse off and change into comfortable clothes before heading out.

What is the cancellation policy for charters?

We offer free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. Within 48 hours, a 50% fee applies. In case of weather cancellation by the captain, you receive a full refund or reschedule.
